topic: compass/invariant — outputs are directional signals, not product truth
decision: Compass behaviors, gaps, pathways, and bets are LLM-synthesised directional signals. They must never be presented as authoritative product state. All output surfaces must include a confidence score and a generated_at timestamp.
key_insight: Compass outputs are directional signals synthesised from project structure — not authoritative product state. Confidence + generated_at are mandatory.
alternatives_considered: Omit confidence scores for cleaner output
rejected_reason: Without confidence scores consumers cannot distinguish high-signal from speculative findings
